amendments.retained_partial: raw/g17p_20260829_run01 (2,306 cases under matrix v1) is RETAINED EXACTLY AS IT STOPPED, not topped up, not reused, not deleted. The gated pair is run02 + run03 under matrix v2.
amendments.touches: case SELECTION only. Nothing in program construction, splicing, poisoning, majority-of-3, victim classification, the sentinels, the oracle or outcome classification changed.
amendments.what: Case matrix reduced from 38,089 to 23,267 cases and the redundant IADD2_64 arm dropped; harness/run.py round-trips the mutated BLOCK instead of the whole 2412-byte padded program; harness/run.py gains --order forward|reverse.
amendments.why: Measured throughput on G17P is ~3.3 dispatches/s (dominated by per-request MTLLibrary+pipeline creation from the spliced archive, not by our Python). The original matrix needed ~3.4 h per gated run, ~7 h for the pair, with a network drop already having killed one dispatch. The reduction sweeps DENSELY exactly the fields that are below emitter grade in tools/agx-isa/validation.json - the ones that actually decide whether an instruction becomes emittable - and samples (boundaries + all powers of two + interior points, ~30 values) the fields already at emitter grade, which are only being CONFIRMED on G17P and are never promoted from a sampled sweep. IADD2_64 tested the same instruction as IADD2 in a second carrier; EXP-0146 already covered the u64 form on M4.
